# Souq Raqami

> Souq Raqami is the digital e-market of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It is an electronic marketplace for digital products and services in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — downloadable products, creative services, content & media services, and templates & digital assets. The market is gearing up for launch; this site is its launch and content home, with practical guides for digital sellers and buyers.

## Categories (at launch)

- Digital Products: products made once and delivered electronically — e-books, recorded courses, ready-to-use work files and sheets, for instant download.
- Creative Services: graphic design, video editing, brand identities and social media designs, delivered remotely by independent designers, editors and studios.
- Content & Media Services: content writing and translation, UGC video production for brands, and social media management & marketing — the category where the influUGC team itself sells its services.
- Templates & Digital Assets: presentation and design templates, design elements, icons and backgrounds, and ready-made business forms, contracts and sheets.

## Guides (on the homepage)

- What is a digital product, and how do you start selling one? Define it from a skill you have, package it with organised files, an honest preview, a complete description and a written licence; choose a marketplace or your own store; instant delivery and support build your rating.
- How do you price a digital product? Price from the value the buyer receives, not your hours; study your category's range; cover channel fees, asset licences and support time; build basic and Pro tiers; do not race to the bottom.
- How do you buy safely in digital marketplaces? Always transact inside the platform; read the usage licence (personal vs commercial, number of projects) before paying; judge the seller's profile and reviews; beware pirated "too-cheap originals"; keep your invoice, licence text and a backup of your files.

## For sellers

- Early (founding) sellers are selected before launch: present a digital product or service, pass a quality / licence-clarity review, and the seller page is prepared before opening — so sales and reviews start from day one.
